seo.title: Common Multiples of 2 and 3 - LCM 6 Speed Grid
seo.metaDescription: Find all numbers divisible by both 2 and 3 on a 100-number grid. Master least common multiples and divisibility rules in this math speed challenge.
seo.intro: When an integer is divisible by both 2 and 3, it must also be a multiple of their least common multiple, which is 6 (2 x 3 = 6). In this game, students identify numbers that satisfy both conditions: the number must be even and its digit sum must be divisible by 3. Finding all 16 common multiples on the 100-grid cements divisibility integration and fraction denominator mastery.
seo.howToPlay: Click all numbers between 1 and 100 that are multiples of both 2 and 3 (multiples of 6). Correct tiles highlight green with a checkmark. Distractor clicks flash red and cost 2 seconds. Find all 16 common multiples before time expires.
seo.teacherNotes: Have students test numbers by applying the two-step rule: first check if it is even, then sum the digits to see if 3 divides into the sum.

faq.q: What is the least common multiple (LCM) of 2 and 3?
faq.a: The LCM of 2 and 3 is 6. Therefore, all common multiples of 2 and 3 are multiples of 6.

faq.q: How many common multiples of 2 and 3 are under 100?
